Tua-Seen-Meem .
yeh uss kitab ki aayaten hain jo haqeeqat wazeh kernay wali hai .
hum emaan walay logon  kay faeeday kay liye tumhen musa aur firon kay kuch halaat theek theek parh ker sunatay hain .

waqiaa yeh hai kay firon ney zameen mein sarkashi ikhtiyar ker rakhi thi , aur uss ney wahan kay bashindon ko alag alag girohon mein taqseem kerdiya tha jinn mein say aik giroh ko uss ney itna daba ker rakha huwa tha kay unn kay beton ko zibah ker deta ,   aur unn ki aurton ko zinda chorr deta tha . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh unn logon  mein say tha jo fasad phelaya kertay hain .
aur hum yeh chahtay thay kay jinn logon  ko zameen mein daba ker rakha gaya hai , unn per ehsan keren , unn ko peshwa banayen , unhi ko ( mulk o maal ka ) waris bana den ,
aur unhen zameen mein iqtidar ata kren , aur firon , hamaan aur unn kay lashkaron ko wohi kuch dikha den jiss say bachao ki woh tadbeeren ker rahey thay .

aur hum ney musa ki walida ko ilhaam kiya kay :  tum iss ( bacchay ) ko doodh pilao , phir jab tumhen iss kay baaray mein koi khatra ho to issay darya mein daal dena , aur darna nahi , aur naa sadma kerna , yaqeen rakho hum ussay wapis tumharay paas phoncha ker rahen gay , aur uss ko payghumberon mein say aik payghumber banayen gay .

iss tarah firon kay logon  ney uss bacchay ( yani hazrat musa aleh-assalam ) ko utha liya , takay aakhir kaar woh unn kay liye dushman aur ghum ka zariya banay . beyshak firon , hamaan aur unn kay lashkar baray khatakaar thay .

aur firon ki biwi ney ( firon say ) kaha kay :  yeh baccha meri aur tumhari aankhon ki thandak hai . issay qatal naa kero , kuch baeed nahi kay yeh hamen faeeda phonchaye , ya hum issay beta bana len .  aur ( yeh faisla kertay waqt ) unhen anjam ka pata nahi tha .
udhar musa ki walida ka dil bey qarar tha . qareeb tha kay woh yeh sara raz khol deyten , agar hum ney unn kay dil ko sanbhala naa hota , takay woh ( humaray waday per ) yaqeen kiye rahen .
aur unhon ney musa ki behan say kaha kay :  iss bacchay ka kuch suragh lagao .  chunacheh uss ney bacchay ko door say iss tarah dekha kay unn logon  ko pata nahi chala .

aur hum ney musa per pehlay hi say yeh bandish laga di thi kay woh doodh pilaney waliyan unhen doodh naa pila-saken , iss liye unn ki behan ney kaha :  kiya mein tumhen aesay ghar ka pata bataon jiss kay log tumharay liye iss bacchay ki perwerish keren , aur iss kay khair khuwa rahen-?

iss tarah hum ney musa ko unn ki maa kay paas loata diya , takay unn ki aankh thandi rahey , aur woh ghumgeen naa hon , aur takay unhen achi tarah maloom hojaye kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .
aur jab musa apni bharpoor tawanai ko phonchay aur pooray jawan hogaye to hum ney unhen hikmat aur ilm say nawaza , aur naik logon  ko hum yun hi sila diya kertay hain .

aur ( aik din ) woh shehar mein aesay waqt dakhil huye jab uss kay bashinday ghaflat mein thay ,   to unhon ney dekha kay wahan do aadmi larr rahey hain , aik to unn ki apni biradari ka tha , aur doosra unn ki dushman qoam ka . abb jo shaks unn ki biradari ka tha , uss ney unhen unn ki dushman qoam kay aadmi kay muqablay mein madad kay liye pukara , iss per musa ney uss ko aik mukka maara jiss ney uss ka kaam tamam kerdiya .   ( phir ) unhon ney ( pachta ker ) kaha kay :  yeh to koi shetan ki kaarawai hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh aik khula dushman hai jo ghalat raastay per daal deta hai .

kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mein ney apni jaan per zulm kerliya , aap mujhay moaaf farma-dijiye .    chunacheh Allah ney unhen moaaf kerdiya . yaqeenan wohi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! aap ney jo mujh per inaam kiya hai , to mein aaenda kabhi mujrimon ka madadgaar nahi banon ga .

phir subha kay waqt woh shehar mein dartay dartay halaat ka jaeza ley rahey thay , itney mein dekha kay jiss shaks ney kal unn say madad maangi thi , woh phir unhen fariyad kay liye pukar raha hai . musa ney uss say kaha kay :  maloom huwa kay tum to khullam khula shareer aadmi ho .

phir jab unhon ney uss shaks ko pakarney ka irada kiya jo inn dono ka dushman tha to uss ( israeeli ) ney kaha :  musa ! kiya tum mujhay bhi ussi tarah qatal kerna chahtay ho jaisay tum ney kal aik aadmi ko qatal kerdiya tha-?   tumhara maqsad iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay tum zameen mein apni zabardasti jamao , aur tum musleh banna nahi chahtay .

aur ( uss kay baad yeh huwa kay ) shehar kay bilkul door daraz ilaqay say aik shaks dorrta huwa aaya , uss ney kaha kay :  musa ! sardar log tumharay baaray mein mashwaray ker rahey hain kay tumhen qatal ker daalen , iss liye tum yahan say nikal jao , yaqeen rakho mein tumharay khair khuwahon mein say hon .
chunacheh musa dartay dartay , halaat ka jaeza letay shehar say nikal kharray huye . kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay zalim logon  say bacha ley .
aur jab unhon ney madiyan ki taraf rukh kiya to kaha kay :  mujhay poori umeed hai kay mera perwerdigar mujhay seedhay raastay per daal dey ga .

aur jab woh madiyan kay kunaen per phonchay to dekha kay uss per aesay logon  ka aik majmaa hai jo apney janweron ko paani pila rahey hain , aur dekha kay unn say pehlay do aurten hain jo apney janweron ko rokay kharri hain . musa ney unn say kaha :  tum kiya chahti ho-?  unn dono ney kaha :  hum apney janweron ko uss waqt tak paani nahi pila sakten jab tak saray charwahey paani pila ker nahi nikal nahi jatay , aur humaray walid boht boorhay aadmi hain .

iss per musa ney unn ki khatir unn kay janweron ko paani pila diya ,   phir murr ker aik saye ki jagah chalay gaye , aur kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! jo koi behtari to mujh per oopper say nazil kerday , mein uss ka mohtaj hun .

thori dair baad unn dono aurton mein say aik unn kay paas sharam o haya kay sath chalti hoi aai ,   kehney lagi :  meray walid aap ko bula rahey hain , takay aap ko iss baat ka inaam den kay aap ney humari khatir janweron ko paani pilaya hai .    chunacheh jab woh aurton kay walid kay paas phonchay aur unn ko sari sarghuzisht sunai , to unhon ney kaha :  koi andesha naa kero , tum zalim logon  say bach aaye ho .

unn dono aurton mein say aik ney kaha :  abba jaan ! aap inn ko ujrat per koi kaam dey dijiye . aap kissi say ujrat per kaam len to iss kay liye behtareen shaks woh hai jo taqatwar bhi ho , amanat daar bhi .

unn kay baap ney kaha :  mein chahta hun kay apni inn do larkiyon mein say aik say tumhara nikah kerdun , ba-shartey-kay tum aath saal tak ujrat per meray paas kaam kero ,   phir agar tum das saal pooray kerdo to yeh tumhara apna faisla hoga . aur mera koi irada nahi hai kay tum per mushaqqat daalun , inn sha Allah tum mujhay unn logon  mein say pao gay jo bhalai ka moamla kertay hain .

musa ney kaha :  yeh baat meray aur aap kay darmiyan tey hogaee . dono muddaton mein say jo bhi mein poori kerdun , to mujh per koi ziyadti naa hogi , aur jo baat hum ker rahey hain , Allah uss ka rakhwala hai .

phir jab musa ney woh mauddat poori kerli , aur apni ehliya ko ley ker chalay   to unhon ney koh-e-toor ki taraf say aik aag dekhi . unhon ney apney ghar walon say kaha :  thehrao ! mein ney aik aag dekhi hai , shayad mein wahan say tumharay paas koi khabar ley aaon , ya aag ka koi angara utha laon , takay tum garmaee hasil ker-sako .

chunacheh jab woh uss aag kay paas phonchay to dayen wadi kay kinaray per jo barkat walay ilaqay mein waqay thi , aik darkht say aawaz aai kay :  aey musa ! mein hi Allah hun , tamam jahano ka perwerdigar !

aur yeh kay :  apni laathi neechay daal do .  phir huwa yeh kay jab unhon ney uss laathi ko dekha kay woh iss tarah harkat ker rahi hai jaisay woh saanp ho , to woh peeth pher ker bhagay , aur murr ker bhi naa dekha .   ( unn say kaha gaya : )  musa ! samney aao , aur daro nahi , tum bilkul mehfooz ho .

apna haath apney giraybaan mein daalo , woh kissi beemari kay baghair chamakta huwa niklay ga , aur darr door kernay kay liye apna bazoo apney jism say lipta lena .   abb yeh do zabardast daleelen hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say firon aur uss kay darbariyon kay paas bheji jarahi hain . woh baray nafarman log hain .
musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! mein ney unn ka aik aadmi qatal kerdiya tha , iss liye mujhay darr hai kay woh mujhay qatal naa kerden .

aur meray bhai Haroon ki zaban mujh say ziyada saaf hai ,   iss liye unn ko bhi meray sath madadgaar bana ker bhej dijiye kay woh meri taeed keren . mujhay andesha hai kay woh log mujhay jhutlayen gay .

irshad huwa :  hum tumharay bhai kay zariye tumharay haath mazboot kiye detay hain , aur tum dono ko aisa dabdaba ata ker-detay hain kay unn ko humari nishaniyon ki barkat say tum per dastaras hasil nahi hogi , tum aur tumharay perokaar hi ghalib raho gay .

chunacheh jab musa unn kay paas humari khuli hoi nishaniyan ley ker phonchay to unhon ney kaha :  yeh kuch nahi , bus banwati jadoo hai , aur hum ney yeh baat apney pichlay baap dadon mein nahi suni .

aur musa ney kaha :  mera perwerdigar khoob janta hai kay kon uss kay paas say hidayat ley ker aaya hai , aur aakhir kaar behtar thikana kiss kay haath aaye ga ,   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay zalim log falah nahi payen gay .

aur firon bola :  aey darbar walo ! mein to apney siwa tumharay kissi aur khuda say waqif nahi hun . hamaan ! tum aisa kero kay meray liye garay ko aag dey ker pakwao , aur meray liye aik oonchi imarat banao , takay mein uss per say musa kay khuda ko jhank ker dekhun ,   aur mein to pooray yaqeen kay sath yeh samajhta hun kay yeh shaks jhoota hai .
gharz yeh kay uss ney aur uss kay lashkaron ney zameen mein nahaq ghamand kiya , aur yeh samajh bethay kay unhen humaray paas wapis nahi laya jaye ga .
iss liye hum ney uss ko aur uss kay lashkaron ko pakar mein ley ker samandar mein phenk diya . abb dekh lo kay zalimon ka anjam kaisa huwa .
hum ney unhen quaid banaya tha jo logon  ko dozakh ki taraf bulatay thay , aur qayamat kay din unn ko kissi ki madad nahi phonchay gi .
duniya mein hum ney lanat unn kay peechay laga di hai , aur qayamat kay din woh unn logon  mein shamil hon gay jinn ki buri halat honey wali hai .
hum ney pichli ummaton ko halak kernay kay baad musa ko aesi kitab di thi jo logon  kay liye baseerat ki baaton per mushtamil , aur sarapa hidayat o rehmat thi , takay woh naseehat hasil keren .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum uss waqt ( koh-e-toor ki ) maghribi janib mojood nahi thay jab hum ney musa ko ehkaam supurd kiye thay ,   aur naa tum unn logon  mein say thay jo uss ka mushaeeda ker rahey hon .

balkay unn kay baad hum ney boht si naslen peda ken , jinn per taweel zamana guzar gaya aur tum madiyan kay basney walon kay darmiyan bhi muqeem nahi thay kay unn ko humari aayaten parh ker sunatay ho , balkay ( tumhen ) Rasool bananey walay hum hain ,

aur naa tum uss waqt toor kay kinaray mojood thay jab hum ney ( musa ko ) pukara tha , balkay yeh tumharay rab ki rehmat hai ( kay tumhen wahi kay zariye yeh baaten batai jarahi hain ) takay tum uss qoam ko khabrdar kero jiss kay paas tum say pehlay koi khabrdar kernay wala nahi aaya , shayad woh naseehat qubool kerlen .

aur takay jab unn logon  per unn kay haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say koi museebat aaye to woh yeh naa keh saken kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney humaray paas koi Rasool kiyon nahi bheja kay hum aap ki aayaton ki perwi kertay aur emaan walon mein hum bhi shamil hojatay-?

phir jab unn kay paas humari taraf say haq aagaya to kehney lagay kay :  iss payghumber ko uss jaisi cheez kiyon nahi di gaee jaisi musa ( aleh-assalam ) ko di gaee thi-?    halankay jo cheez musa ko di gaee thi , kiya unhon ney pehlay hi uss ka inkar nahi kerdiya tha-? unhon ney kaha tha kay :  yeh dono jadoo hain jo aik doosray ki taeed kertay hain , aur unhon ney kaha kay  hum inn mein say her aik kay munkir hain .
. ( inn say ) kaho :  acha , agar tum sachay ho to Allah kay paas say koi aur aesi kitab ley aao jo inn dono say ziyada hidayat per mushtamil ho , mein uss ki ittaba kerlun ga .

phir agar yeh tumhari farmaeesh poori naa keren , to samajh lo kay dar-haqeeqat yeh log apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chal rahey hain . aur uss say ziyada gumrah kon hoga jo Allah ki taraf say aai hoi hidayat kay baghair bus apni khuwaish kay peechay chalay-? beyshak Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat nahi deta .
aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum inn kay faeeday kay liye aik kay baad aik ( naseehat ki ) baat bhejtay rahey hain ,   takay woh mutanabeh hon .
jinn ko hum ney Quran say pehlay aasmani kitaben di hain , woh iss ( Quran ) per emaan latay hain ,

aur jab woh unn ko parh ker sunaya jata hai to kehtay hain kay :  hum iss per emaan laye , yaqeenan yeh bar-haq kalam hai jo humaray perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai . hum to iss say pehlay bhi issay mantay thay .

aesay logon  ko unn ka sawab dohra diya jaye ga , kiyonkay unhon ney sabar say kaam liya   aur woh naiki say burai ka dafiya kertay hain ,   aur hum ney jo kuch unn ko diya hai , uss mein say ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kertay hain .

aur jab woh koi beyhooda baat suntay hain to ussay taal jatay hain , aur kehtay hain kay :  humaray liye humaray aemal hain , aur tumharay liye tumharay aemal . hum tumhen salam kertay hain .   hum nadan logon  say ulajhna nahi chahtay .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum jiss ko khud chahao hidayat tak nahi phoncha saktay , balkay Allah jiss ko chahta hai hidayat tak phoncha deta hai , aur hidayat qubool kernay walon ko wohi khoob janta hai .

aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  agar hum aap kay sath hidayat ki perwi keren gay to hamen apni zameen say koi uchak kerlay jaye ga .    bhala kiya hum ney inn ko uss haram mein jagah nahi dey rakhi jo itna pur aman hai kay her qisam kay phal uss ki taraf khinchay chalay aatay hain , jo khaas humari taraf say diya huwa rizq hai-? lekin unn mein say aksar log nahi jantay .

aur kitni hi bastiyan woh hain jo apni maeeshat per itrati then , hum ney unn ko tabah ker daala , abb woh unn ki rehaeesh gaahen tumharay samney hain , jo unn kay baad thoray arsay ko chorr ker kabhi abad hi naa hosaken , aur hum hi thay jo unn kay waris banay .

aur tumhara perwerdigar aisa nahi hai kay woh bastiyan yunhi halak ker daalay jab tak uss ney unn bastiyon kay markazi maqam per koi Rasool naa bheja ho jo unn ko humari aayaten parh ker sunaye , aur hum bastiyon ko uss waqt tak halak kernay walay nahi hain jab tak unn kay bashinday zalim naa ban jayen .

aur tum ko jo kuch bhi diya gaya hai , woh dunyawi zindagi ki poonji aur uss ki sajawat hai aur jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh kahen ziyada behtar aur kahen ziyada payedaar hai . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?

bhala batao kay jiss shaks say hum ney acha saa wada ker rakha hai , aur woh uss waday ko paa-ker rahey ga , kiya woh uss jaisa hosakta hai jissay hum ney dunyawi zindagi ki poonji kay kuch mazay dey diye hain , phir woh unn logon  mein shamil honey wala hai jo qayamat kay din dhar liye jayen gay-?
aur woh din ( kabhi naa bhoolo ) jab Allah unn logon  ko pukaray ga aur kahey ga :  kahan hain ( khudai mein ) meray woh shareek jinn ka tum dawa kiya kertay thay-?

jinn kay khilaf ( Allah ki ) baat poori hochuki hogi ,   woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! yeh log jinn ko hum ney gumrah kiya tha , hum ney inn ko ussi tarah gumrah kiya jaisay hum khud gumrah huye .   hum aap kay samney inn say dast bardar hotay hain , yeh humari ibadat nahi kertay thay .

aur ( unn kafiron say ) kaha jaye ga kay :  pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha tha !  chunacheh woh unn ko pukaren gay , magar woh unn ko jawab nahi den gay , aur yeh azab aankhon say dekh len gay . kaash yeh aesay hotay kay hidayat ko qubool kerletay !
aur woh din ( bhi hergiz naa bhoolo ) jab Allah unn ko pukaray ga , aur kahey ga :  tum ney payghumberon ko kiya jawab diya tha-?
iss per sari baaten ( jo yeh banaya kertay hain ) iss/uss din bey nishan hochuki hon gi , chunacheh woh aapas mein aik doosray say kuch pooch bhi nahi saken gay .
albatta jinn logon  ney tauba kerli , aur emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal kiye , to poori umeed hai kay woh unn logon  mein shamil hon gay jinhen falah hasil hogi .
aur tumhara perwerdigar jo chahta hai peda kerta hai , aur ( jo chahta hai ) pasand kerta hai . unn ko koi ikhtiyar nahi hai .   Allah unn kay shirk say pak aur boht baala o bartar hai .
aur tumhara perwerdigar unn baaton ko bhi janta hai jo unn kay seenay chupaye huye hain , aur unn baaton ko bhi jo yeh khullam khula kertay hain .
Allah wohi hai uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi , tareef ussi ki hai , duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi . aur hukum ussi ka chalta hai , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb wapis bhejay jao gay .

. ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho :  zara yeh batlao kay agar Allah tum per raat ko hamesha kay liye qayamat kay din tak musallat rakhay to Allah kay siwa konsa mabood hai jo tumharay paas roshni ley ker aaye-? bhala kiya tum suntay nahi ho-?

kaho :  zara yeh batlao kay agar Allah tum per din ko hamesha kay liye qayamat kay din tak musallat kerday to Allah kay siwa konsa mabood hai jo tumhen woh raat laaker deydey jiss mein tum sukoon hasil ker-sako-? bhala kiya tumhen kuch sujhai nahi deta-?
yeh to ussi ney apni rehmat say tumharay liye raat bhi banai hai aur din bhi , takay tum uss mein sukoon hasil kero , aur uss mein Allah ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay tum shukar ada kero .
aur woh din ( naa bhoolo ) jab woh inn ( mushrikon ) ko pukaray ga , aur kahey ga kay :  kahan hain ( khudai mein ) meray woh shareek jinn ka tum dawa kiya kertay thay ?

aur hum her ummat mein say aik gawahi denay wala nikal layen gay , phir kahen gay kay :  lao apni koi daleel !  uss waqt unn ko pata chal jaye ga kay sachi baat Allah hi ki thi , aur woh sari baaten jo unhon ney gharr rakhi then , sabb gumm ho ker reh jayen gi .

qaroon musa ki qoam ka aik shaks tha ,   phir uss ney unhi per ziyadti ki .   aur hum ney ussay itney khazaney diye thay kay uss ki chabiyan taqatwar logon  ki aik jamat say bhi mushkil say uthti then . aik waqt tha jab uss ki qoam ney uss say kaha kay :  itrao nahi , Allah itraney walon ko pasand nahi kerta ,

aur Allah ney tumhen jo kuch dey rakha hai , uss kay zariye aakhirat wala ghar bananey ki koshish kero ,   aur duniya mein say bhi apney hissay ko nazar andaz naa kero ,   aur jiss tarah Allah ney tum per ehsan kiya hai , tum bhi ( doosron per ) ehsan kero ,   aur zameen mein fasad machaney ki koshish naa kero . yaqeen jano Allah fasad machaney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

kehney laga :  yeh sabb kuch to mujhay khud apney ilm ki wajeh say mila hai .  bhala kiya ussay itna bhi ilm nahi tha kay Allah ney uss say pehli naslon kay aesay aesay logon  ko halak ker daala tha jo taqat mein bhi uss say ziyada mazboot thay ,   aur jinn ki jamiyat bhi ziyada thi . aur mujrimon say unn kay gunahon kay baaray mein poocha bhi nahi jata .

phir ( aik din ) woh apni qoam kay samney apni aan baan kay sath nikla . jo log dunyawi zindagi kay talab gaar thay , woh kehney lagay :  aey kaash ! humaray paas bhi woh cheezen hoten jo qaroon ko ata ki gaee hain . yaqeenan woh baray naseebon wala hai .

aur jinn logon  ko ( Allah ki taraf say ) ilm ata huwa tha , unhon ney kaha :  tum per afsos hai ( kay tum aisa keh rahey ho ) . Allah ka diya huwa sawab uss shaks kay liye kahen ziyada behtar hai jo emaan laye aur naik amal keray , aur woh unhi ko milta hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain .

phir huwa yeh kay hum ney ussay aur uss kay ghar ko zameen mein dhansa diya , phir ussay koi aisa giroh moyassar naa aaya jo Allah kay muqablay mein uss ki madad kerta aur naa woh khud apna bachao ker-saka .

aur kal jo log uss jaisa honey ki tamanna ker rahey thay , kehney lagay :  ooho ! pata chal gaya kay Allah apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai . agar Allah ney hum per ehsan naa kiya hota to woh hamen bhi zameen mein dhansa deta . ooho ! pata chal gaya kay kafir log falah nahi paatay .
woh aakhirat wala ghar to hum unn logon  kay liye makhsoos kerden gay jo zameen mein naa to barai chahtay hain , aur naa fasad , aur aakhri anjam perhezgaron kay haq mein hoga .

jo shaks koi naiki ley ker aaye ga to uss ko uss say behtar cheez milay gi , aur jo koi badi ley ker aaye ga to jinhon ney buray kaam kiye hain , unn ko kissi aur cheez ki nahi , unn kay kiye huye kamon hi ki saza di jaye gi .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) jiss zaat ney tum per iss Quran ki zimma daari daali hai , woh tumhen dobara uss jagah per laaker rahey ga jo ( tumharay liye ) unsiyat ki jagah hai .   keh do :  mera rab uss say bhi khoob waqif hai jo hidayat ley ker aaya hai , aur uss say bhi jo khuli gumrah mein mubtala hai .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhen pehlay say yeh umeed nahi thi kay tum per yeh kitab nazil ki jaye gi , lekin yeh tumharay rab ki taraf say rehmat hai , lehaza kafiron kay hergiz madadgaar naa banna .

aur jab Allah ki aayaten tum per nazil kerdi gaee hain , to iss kay baad yeh log tumhen hergiz unn ( per amal kernay ) say rokney naa payen . aur tum apney rab ki taraf logon  ko dawat detay raho , aur hergiz inn mushrikeen mein shamil naa hona .

aur Allah kay sath kissi aur mabood ko naa pukaro . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . her cheez fana honey wali hai , siwaye uss ki zaat kay . hukoomat ussi ki hai , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen lotaya jaye ga .
